newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Int'l Indonesia HK unit sets loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank Int'l Indonesia HK unit sets loan.

text.p: The following transferable loan facility was announced by the joint arrangers.
BORROWER BII FINANCE COMPANY LTD
AMOUNT US$30 MLN TYPE TRANSFERABLE LOAN
MARGIN 6ML+150BP MATURITY 3 YRS AVGE LIFE --
PUTS YR 2 CALLS -- LAUNCHED 01.MAY.97
DRAWDOWN ONE LUMP SUM AVAIL 30 DAYS REPLIES 22.MAY.97
REPAYMENT BULLET HOME CTRY HONG KONG GOV LAW ENGLISH
SIGNING 06.JUN.97
ARRANGERS KMBC ASIA AND STANDARD CHARTERED BANK
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
CO-LEAD MANAGERS US$4-5 MLN 50BP ALL-IN 175
SENIOR MANAGERS US$2-3 MLN 40BP ALL-IN 170
NOTES THE BORROWER IS REGISTERED AS A DEPOSIT-TAKING CO IN
HONG KONG. PT BANK INTERNATIONAL INDONESIA (BII)
SHALL MAINTAIN ITS 100 PCT BENEFICIAL
OWNERSHIP IN THE BORROWER THROUGHOUT THE LIFE OF THE
FACILITY. THE FACILITY IS SECURED BY A LETTER OF
COMFORT FROM BII. PROCEEDS WILL BE USED FOR GENERAL
WORKING CAPITAL.
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
